name: Michael J. Jaurigue
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Glendale, California
education: University of California Berkeley School of Law
about: As the founder and senior trial attorney at JLG Lawyers in Glendale, California, Michael J. Jaurigue represents clients in employment and labor matters. His practice focuses on advocating for individuals and businesses involved in employment-related disputes, with an emphasis on strategic representation and effective resolution of complex legal issues.

Over the course of his legal career, Mr. Jaurigue has developed extensive experience representing clients in litigation and settlement negotiations. He has negotiated more than $800 million in settlements on behalf of his clients, reflecting his experience handling substantial and complex matters. As a senior trial attorney, he works closely with clients to understand their legal concerns, develop effective strategies and pursue favorable outcomes throughout the legal process.

Mr. Jaurigue earned his bachelor’s degree in philosophy from the University of California, Los Angeles, graduating magna cum laude. He went on to attend the UC Berkeley School of Law, where he earned his Juris Doctor in 1999. He was admitted to practice law in California in 2000, allowing him to represent clients in state legal matters throughout the state.

In addition to his legal practice, Mr. Jaurigue remains active in numerous professional and legal organizations. He is a member of the California Employment Lawyers Association, Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles, American Association for Justice, Los Angeles County Bar Association, Southern California Bankruptcy Inns of Court, San Fernando Valley Bar Association, Filipino American Bar Association, American Bar Association, Asian Pacific American Bar Association and United Mortgage Modifiers Association of America.

Through his legal practice and professional involvement, Mr. Jaurigue continues to serve clients in employment and labor matters while remaining engaged with the broader legal community. His background in litigation, substantial settlement negotiations and active participation in professional organizations contribute to his work as an experienced employment and labor attorney.
